title: Combining gears
text: The rotation rate of each gear combines through a conversion factor problem that connects the rotation rates as products.

title: Blue gear rotation rate
text: The pink gear rotates at $$\frac{12}{1}$$ RPM. The blue gear rotates at the rate $$\frac{12}{1} \frac{1}{3}=\frac{4}{1}$$ RPM

title: Yellow gear rotation rate
text: The yellow gear rotates at the same rotation rate as the blue gear, they are connected. The yellow gear rotates at the rate $$\frac{4}{1} \frac{1}{1}$$ RPM.

title: Orange gear rotation rate
text: The orange gear rotates at the yellow gear's rate times the reduction factor: $$\frac{4}{1} \frac{1}{2}$$ $$=$$ $$2$$ RMP. \n Note that $$\frac{4}{1}$$ is the rotation rate of the yellow gear, and $$\frac{1}{2}$$ is the factor of the number of rotations of the orange gear per rotation of the yellow gear.
